scope: Predefined source-adjudicated labels for all selected current original Kotlin fixtures. Source locations distinguish multiple anchors in one callable. Labels are frozen before changed-input model review; ordinary observation dismissals do not certify unspecified inputs, callbacks or configuration. No whole-application recall, deployment exposure, compiler completeness or all-platform Kotlin parity claim. Fixed-command review exclusions and foreign lookalikes are tested separately.
